chat_history.content:
A one story, big on the outside (very big!), modern with a infinity pool. 

Inside the Kitchen has to be very big and very open with a hughe islend. Then the dining room has to be almost secluded. 

The living room were the couches are has to almost lowerd, giving it a grounded comfy feel. 

There has to be a spaar room and elevator, 3 bedrooms and 4 baths, 2 garages, and a bascetball court outside and a theater room.
A little area that has a greenhouse for our plants, a planting area, and a hourse stabel next to the house.
